verdict.rationale: Salv's AI-Powered Insights is an in-product AI feature that adjudicates sanctions name matches and explains its reasoning, so it covers AI review of screening matches with a rationale. It is informational only: it never closes an alert or makes the decision. The evidence does not show that its rationale is recorded on the alert's audit trail; the audit trail cited covers rule-based auto-closures, not the AI's reasoning. missing for 10: evidence that the AI rationale is persisted on the alert record, any agentic action beyond advisory output, depth documentation of the feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to review screening matches with recorded rationale

citations.quote: AI-Powered Insights adjudicates a name match and explains its reasoning, but it's informational only: it never closes an alert or makes the decision.
